mentions.name: xpire
mentions.description: A CLI tool, written in Go, that adds expiry dates to filesystem structures. It leverages filesystem-specific features (such as snapshots) to avoid long treewalks when searching and stores the dates in the filesystem itself rather than a separate database. It currently supports btrfs snapshots and zfs datasets.
mentions.problem: Long treewalks for searching expiry dates and the need for a separate database to store them.
